subject: MVTHS Cosmetology Shop Profile
overview: Medford Vocational Technical High School cosmetology instructor Julie Morrow and students presented a profile of the shop's hands-on curriculum, student experiences, and post-graduation pathways.

items.title: Cosmetology Shop Profile Overview
items.summary: Instructor Julie Morrow and students Danelle, Skyla, Isabel, and Leticia detailed the cosmetology program's hands-on services with live clients, favorite projects, and career pathways ranging from salon ownership to aesthetics and barbering.
